# RunWield

> RunWield is a plan- and lifecycle-centered coding harness that turns a rough idea into a collaborative Plan, deliberate execution, validation, and a durable Work Record.

RunWield is for developers using AI on real codebases where intent, risk, and proof matter more than typing speed. It is not a pull-request review bot or an autonomous vibe-coding tool. Its current public surfaces include the `wld` CLI and TUI, browser-based Plan Review, and guided Code Review.

Core workflow: rough idea -> collaborative Plan -> deliberate execution -> validation -> Work Record -> better future planning.

RunWield v0.14.0 and later are open source under the MIT license. The CLI, TUI, personal browser Workspace, and ACP server remain free forever. Model-provider charges are separate; third-party components retain their licenses.

## Product

- [RunWield is open source](https://runwield.dev/blog/runwield-is-open-source): v0.14.0, MIT licensing, repository move, and skills migration.

- [Features](https://runwield.dev/features): Project learning, planning, execution and review, Workspace, models, and customization.

- [Wield Notes](https://runwield.dev/blog): Engineering judgment in the age of AI.

- [RunWield README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RunWield/runwield/main/README.md): Product overview, installation, workflow, architecture, current status, and license summary.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.runwield.dev/quickstart/): Install RunWield, connect a model provider, initialize a project, and run the first task.
- [Documentation index](https://docs.runwield.dev/): Entry point for the complete RunWield documentation.

## Workflows

- [Plans and workflows](https://docs.runwield.dev/workflows/): How RunWield classifies work, creates Plans, executes approved changes, validates results, and records outcomes.
- [Collaboration](https://docs.runwield.dev/collaboration/): Human-agent collaboration modes and review checkpoints.
- [Settings](https://docs.runwield.dev/settings/): Configuration and model-provider settings.
- [Customization](https://docs.runwield.dev/customization/): Project and user customization, agents, prompts, skills, and themes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.runwield.dev/troubleshooting/): Common installation and runtime problems.
